note: Actual shipments confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs bills of lading with destination and HS codes exist for export lanes Russia (Moscow), Jamaica (Kingston), UAE (Dubai), Mauritius (Port Louis), plus Brazil and Indonesia counterparties. Declared HS 901839 matches the observed records (90183920 intra-aortic balloon catheter kits, 90183990 guiding/PTCA catheter, hemostasis Y-connector kit) — no HS correction needed. Company is a trader/distributor, not a manufacturer: it simultaneously imports finished goods and components (e.g. "2026-02-13 | SCW MEDICATH LTD | DOLPHIN LIFE SCIENCE (INDIA) LLP | PARTS AND COMPONENTS FOR INDEFLATOR (GUN TYPE) | ZHENGZHOU, CHINA | 90330000 | BOL 7509258") and re-exports to third-country buyers, so role = trader. Industry claim "Продукты питания и FMCG" is wrong — actual activity is cardiovascular/medical devices (HS 9018/9033); flag for correction, not a rejection ground. Domestic India supply evidence not found in reachable sources; recorded as unknown rather than assumed.
